specification.smoke_selection: Fixed before any new states: val_31 covers sole-composer redundant-negative branch; val_35 covers calendar-date value branch. All their cells plus both cached baselines are recomputed. No semantic-result selection.
specification.construction: 50 cells =10 cached CS0 baselines +20 authored-value positive cores +12 authored-value redundant-negative cores +8 alternate-value positive cores.40 new formal forwards plus12 smoke forwards. Both target documents changed together; questions, three complete backgrounds, native slots and duplicates fixed.
specification.note: Cell codes are identities only and never enter the prompt. Nine contrasts,60 paired rows,10 repeated exposed bases; variable support per comparison(10/6/4). Baseline-to-core changes whole targets, duplication and some incidental propositions, not a pure style contrast. D-to-P preserves question-answer propositions within cores; authored-to-alternate changes the answer value consistently in both targets; negative suffixes follow already exhaustive classifications/sole composer. Positive means no added redundant-negative suffix; scope/exclusivity wording remains explicit.
specification.limits: These are authored counterfactuals with same-exposed-assistant review, not independent semantic gold or real-world truth. Wording and negative edits also change length; value changes identity/date and tokenization, not measured truth familiarity. Descriptive train-only lexical counts are not semantic/OOD certification. No training/calibration/layer/threshold selection, new semantic accuracy, answers/behavior, original test/confirmation or patching.

feature_convention: H[l] = hidden_states[l+1][0,-1,:]; final layer includes decoder final norm
forward: decoder-only prefill, use_cache=False, BF16/SDPA; no LM head, no generation, no feedback
no_training: No fitting, calibration, layer/threshold selection or feedback.
no_generation: No LM head, generated answers or new behavior scoring.
no_gold: Same exposed assistant, no independent semantic gold, new accuracy or population claim.
no_test: Same exposed ten val bases plus descriptive fixed train600 counts, no original test/confirmation.
